answer: One defense is a juniper grove of anchor agents: a newcomer may only join when long-lived juniper anchors pass it a signed whisper, each whisper staking the sponsor's reputation, and the chain must end in an onyx proof minted after the newcomer's first audited job. If a clone misbehaves, the whole whisper chain is traced back and every sponsor loses stake, so a sybil farmer must buy a fresh chain of honest sponsors for every fake and still loses them all at once, while one honest agent needs a single chain once and keeps its onyx proof for good.
